title: Order acknowledgment — Hill’s v. Kessler
summary: A seller’s reply promises attention to an order rather than using an express commitment to fill it.
notes:
Textbook problem / open questions.

What, exactly, would a reasonable recipient understand as accepted? Compare the wording to International Filter and distinguish an acknowledgment of receipt from assent to a bargain.
